upstream.package: dspy==3.4.0 (PyPI, in exp895/venv), with optuna==5.0.0 and litellm==1.82.6 (exp895/venv.freeze.txt)
upstream.check: every installed .py of dspy (249), optuna (220) and litellm (1707) matches its wheel RECORD sha256, 0 mismatches (checked 2026-10-21)

port_files: sha256 of each file is filled in by the final step below (see port_files_sha256)
seed: sbv400-main/templates/adapters/spreadsheetbench/seed_capability_v2 (prompt.md, task_template.md, SKILL.md sha256 checked at start against exp895/BUILD_RECORD.json; the seed program renders to these exact bytes)

data.optimizer_sees: train 80 (official split train): MIPRO's dataset summary and instruction proposer see train Examples (task_id, instruction, instruction_type, answer_position; no gold) and bootstrapped demos (a train task passed 3/3 + the agent's own final solution code). The prompt model never sees a score.
data.bootstraps_on: train 80, at most 20% of R rollouts
data.selects_on: val 40 (official split val): optuna's Bayesian search scores minibatches of 8 val tasks and full val every 4 trials; the champion is the best full-val candidate (k=3 mean per task), the seed wins ties
data.test: never loaded by the port; the launcher asserts zero overlap with the official test list

settings.num_threads: CONC // 3 (k=3 trials of each task run inside CommonRollout)
settings.prompt_model: dspy.LM('openai/rits/zai-org/glm-5-3', api_base=gateway :4115 tag exp895-miprov2-s<seed>:optimizer, max_tokens=16000, timeout=3600)
settings.task_model: NoTaskLM sentinel (never called; forward() scores via CommonRollout)

offline_test: test_miprov2_arm.py: the real MIPROv2/Evaluate/optuna against a fake CommonRollout and a scripted prompt LM (exceptions swallowed upstream vs ArmStop propagated, infra trial dropped, demos only from 3/3, R not overshot, seed reused)
